en: The Philippines consists of 7,641 islands, which is 534 more islands than the previously estimated official count of 7,107.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 elected members, whereas the House of Representatives has over 300 members.
The sun on the Philippine flag has 8 rays, representing the first 8 provinces that revolted against Spanish rule.
Although the Philippines has over 180 distinct native languages, only Filipino and English serve as its 2 official languages.
National hero Jose Rizal wrote 2 famous novels, Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo, before his execution at age 35.
The Philippine Supreme Court, the highest judicial branch, is composed of exactly 15 justices, including 1 Chief Justice.
The endangered Philippine Tamaraw, a dwarf buffalo found only in Mindoro, stands just 1 meter tall, much shorter than regular carabaos.
Filipino citizens vote for national leaders like the President every 6 years, but they elect local officials every 3 years.
The peaceful 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution lasted for 4 days and successfully ousted a dictator with over 2 million participants.
There are 110 distinct indigenous cultural communities in the Philippines, comprising roughly 15 percent of the total national population.
Dr. Fe del Mundo designed a bamboo incubator that costs one-tenth of standard medical incubators for rural babies.
The annual Sinulog festival in Cebu features a grand parade with over 100 competing dance contingents honoring the Santo Niño.
